stories.title: Power cut hits part of Shotton and Aston
stories.summary: Part of Shotton and Aston is without power this evening after an unplanned power cut, with SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supplies by 10.39pm. stories.title: Online groomer jailed for 30 years at Chester Crown Court after police trace 70 victims
stories.summary: A man who posed online as a teenage boy called Reece to groom and blackmail girls has been jailed at Chester Crown Court after police traced 70 of his victims across the UK. stories.title: Sandycroft, Pentre and Mancot flooding report left on the shelf for two years, councillors to hear
stories.summary: Councillors’ recommendations for tackling flooding in places like Sandycroft, Pentre and Mancot have waited two years to be adopted, according to a motion going to Flintshire County Council next week. stories.title: Head of north Wales health board quits for English NHS trust
stories.summary: The boss of the health board that runs Wrexham Maelor Hospital and NHS services across Flintshire is leaving for a job in England. Carol Shillabeer, chief executive of Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board, will start as chief executive of Lancashire and South Cumbria NHS Foundation Trust early in the new year. stories.title: Bird keepers across Wales must follow new bird flu rules from Monday
stories.summary: Anyone in Wales who keeps chickens, ducks, geese or other birds must follow new rules to stop the spread of bird flu from midday on Monday 16 November, however few birds they have.
